g.text: Copenhagen | Transfer results and a separate density-informed diagnostic
Exploratory, valid-output conditional; one endpoint-conditioned record, n=50. Spans: model/bank ranges, not CIs.
The bottom row uses target information, NOT a fair transfer competitor. 896 attempts: 890 valid (12 empty), 6 failed; no supplements.
